quarterly_data.signal: ST's Q2 2026 interim report (6-K): 'For 2026, we now plan to invest an amount of Net Capex in the high end of the $2.0 to $2.2 billion range communicated in January, reflecting accelerated investments in selected growth drivers, including Cloud Optical Interconnect'. The capex covers the Catania 200mm SiC plant, the Chongqing 200mm SiC device JV with Sanan Optoelectronics, the Crolles 300mm wafer fab evolution for digital and Cloud Optical Interconnect, the Agrate 300mm ramp for analog mixed signal and smart power, and back-end capacity including a next-generation Panel-Level Packaging pilot line in Tours. Net Capex was $409 million in Q2 2026 and $771 million in the first six months (vs $996 million a year earlier).
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 Net Capex at the high end of $2.0 to $2.2 billion; Q2 Net Capex $409 million; 1H 2026 $771 million

quarterly_data.signal: ST's Q2 2026 interim report (6-K): in the second quarter ST started manufacturing and entered the ramp-up phase of its new 200mm silicon carbide manufacturing in Catania, Italy and of the new 200mm SiC device manufacturing Sanan ST joint venture in Chongqing, China (the JV's capital project reached its ready-for-production date; ST is the JV's sole customer). A total of $1,215 million was reclassified from construction in progress to property, plant and equipment, and the ramp brought $30 million of start-up costs in the quarter.
quarterly_data.figure: 200mm SiC production started Q2 2026 in Catania and Chongqing; $1,215 million moved out of construction in progress; $30 million start-up costs

quarterly_data.signal: ST's Q2 2026 interim report (6-K), segment detail: Power and Discrete (P&D) revenue was $464 million (+19.2% sequentially) with an operating loss of $99 million (-21.4% of revenue; 1H 2026 revenue $853 million, operating loss $183 million); RF Optical Communications (RFOC) revenue was $445 million (+8.6% sequentially) with operating income of $94 million (21.2% of revenue; 1H 2026 revenue $854 million, +32.9%, operating income $155 million). Unused capacity charges fell to $37 million from $103 million a year earlier.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 P&D revenue $464 million, operating loss $99 million; Q2 RFOC revenue $445 million, operating income $94 million (21.2%)

quarterly_data.signal: ST's Q2 2026 interim report (6-K), demand and customer commitments: booking plus net frame orders in Q2 were higher than in Q1 and ST entered Q3 2026 with a backlog higher than when entering Q2. Non-current advances from customers - tied to multi-annual volume commitment agreements, some with take-or-pay clauses - rose to $111 million at June 27, 2026 from $14 million at December 31, 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: non-current customer advances $111 million (vs $14 million at year-end 2025); Q3 entered with higher backlog
